pricing.faqA1: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. When upgrading, you get immediate access to new features. When downgrading, changes apply at the next billing cycle.
pricing.faqA2: Yes. All plans come with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required. You can explore all Pro features during the trial period.
pricing.faqQ3: What payment methods do you accept?
pricing.faqA3: We accept bank transfers and credit cards. For annual plans, we offer a discount equivalent to 2 months free.
pricing.faqQ4: Can I add more users or storage?
pricing.faqA4: Yes. You can purchase additional users and storage as add-ons on any plan. Contact our sales team for custom pricing.
pricing.faqA5: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. We use Supabase and Vercel infrastructure with RLS policies ensuring tenant isolation. You can export all your data at any time from Settings and back up the database via the included command-line scripts. We also perform automated database backups with point-in-time recovery on Pro and higher plans.
pricing.faqQ6: Do you offer onboarding and training?
pricing.faqA6: Yes. All plans include basic onboarding. Pro and Business plans include staff training and data migration assistance. Enterprise plans include dedicated onboarding.

meta.description: TOLOM - Auto Service Management Platform. Everything your auto shop needs to manage work orders, customers, inventory, and finances.

landing.heroSubtitle: TOLOM is the operating system for auto service businesses. From check-in to checkout, manage every aspect of your garage in one place.
landing.feature1Desc: Built for the garage floor. Check in vehicles, assign mechanics, and manage work orders from any tablet — no desktop required.
landing.feature2Desc: Never forget a price. TOLOM remembers service and part prices from past work orders, so you always quote accurately.
landing.feature3Desc: See revenue, active jobs, bay utilization, and mechanic performance updated in real time. Make data-driven decisions.
landing.feature4Desc: Track parts, manage stock levels, automate purchase orders, and get low-stock alerts before you run out.
landing.howItWorksStep1Desc: Customer arrives. Look up their vehicle by plate, record the issue, and create a work order in under 30 seconds.
landing.howItWorksStep2Desc: Assign mechanics, add services and parts, track bay occupancy, and update status in real time from any device.
landing.howItWorksStep3Desc: Close the work order, generate an invoice, take payment, and the customer is on their way. All in one flow.
landing.testimonialsTitle: Trusted by Auto Shops Across Mongolia
landing.testimonial1Text: TOLOM transformed how we run our shop. The tablet workflow alone saved us hours every day. Our mechanics love it.
landing.testimonial2Text: The pricing memory feature is a game changer. We used to spend 10 minutes looking up past prices. Now it's instant.
landing.testimonial3Text: Inventory management used to be a nightmare. Now we track everything in TOLOM — low stock alerts save us every week.
landing.pricingPreviewDesc: Start with what you need, upgrade as you grow. No hidden fees, no long-term contracts.
landing.ctaTitle: Ready to streamline your auto shop?
landing.ctaSubtitle: Start your free trial today. No credit card required. Every feature on this page is ready to use.

features.metaDescription: Explore all features of TOLOM auto service management platform: work orders, CRM, inventory management, real-time dashboard analytics, and more.
features.heroSubtitle: A complete suite of tools designed for the way auto service businesses actually work. No bloat, no complexity — just the right features.
features.categoryGarageOpsDesc: Core tools to run your shop floor efficiently
features.featureWorkOrdersDesc: Create, track, and manage work orders from check-in to completion. Add services, parts, and notes in one place.
features.featureBayViewDesc: Drag-and-drop bay management. See every bay, mechanic, and vehicle at a glance. Assign work with a single click.
features.featureMechanicsDesc: Track mechanic assignments, daily reports, and performance. Know who worked on what and how long it took.
features.featureServiceHistoryDesc: Complete vehicle service history at your fingertips. Every repair, part, and service ever done on a vehicle.
features.featureCustomersDesc: Full customer profiles with contact info, vehicle ownership, visit history, and notes. Search by name, phone, or plate.
features.featureVehiclesDesc: Detailed vehicle records: plate, make, model, year, VIN, engine, transmission, and full service timeline.
features.featureRemindersDesc: Automated service reminders based on mileage or time intervals. Never miss a follow-up opportunity.
features.categoryInventoryDesc: Full control over your parts and stock
features.featurePartsCatalogDesc: Comprehensive parts database with categories, pricing, supplier info, and stock levels. Search and add in seconds.
features.featureStockDesc: Ledger-based inventory tracking. Every movement is recorded — purchases, sales, adjustments, transfers, and returns.
features.featureSuppliersDesc: Manage suppliers, contact info, pricing, and purchase orders. Auto-generate POs when stock runs low.
features.featurePurchaseOrdersDesc: Create, track, and receive purchase orders. Partial receipts, order status tracking, and supplier history.
features.featureDashboardDesc: Real-time KPIs: revenue, active work orders, average repair order, customer counts, and bay utilization.
features.featureReportsDesc: Revenue trends, service mix, mechanic performance, customer acquisition — all visualized with interactive charts.
features.featureFinanceDesc: Generate invoices, track payments, manage expenses, and export financial data. Complete financial oversight.
features.featureMultiTenantDesc: Every organization's data is isolated with Row Level Security. Your data stays yours — completely private and secure.
features.featureRBACDesc: Granular permissions for owners, managers, mechanics, and admin. Control exactly who can see and do what.
features.featureExportDesc: Export all your data anytime. CSV/Excel export for customers, work orders, inventory, and financial reports.
features.faqQ1: Can I try TOLOM before committing?
features.faqA1: Yes! All plans come with a 14-day free trial. No credit card required. You can explore all features during the trial period.
features.faqA2: Absolutely. TOLOM is built tablet-first and works on any device with a modern browser. Mechanics can update work orders from the shop floor.
features.faqQ3: Can I migrate my existing data?
features.faqA3: Yes. We offer data migration assistance for all paid plans. Our team can help import your customer and vehicle data from spreadsheets or other systems.
features.faqA4: Yes. All data is encrypted in transit (TLS) and at rest. We use Supabase infrastructure with Row Level Security ensuring complete data isolation between organizations.

products.metaDescription: TOLOM product suite: Core CRM for essential garage management, Inventory Pro for parts and stock control, Business Suite for multi-branch operations.
products.heroSubtitle: TOLOM is not just a CRM. It's a full operating system for auto service businesses — modular, scalable, and built for the way you work.
products.tierCoreDesc: Essential tools every garage needs. Work orders, customer management, vehicle tracking, basic reports, and tablet-first workflow.
products.tierInventoryDesc: Everything in Core CRM plus full inventory management. Track parts, manage stock, and automate purchasing.
products.tierBusinessDesc: For growing shops and multi-branch operations. Full platform with advanced analytics, API access, and integrations.
products.integrationsDesc: TOLOM connects with the tools you already use. From payment systems to accounting software, we've got you covered.
products.ctaTitle: Find the right plan for your shop

about.metaDescription: Learn about TOLOM's mission to empower auto service businesses in Mongolia with modern, accessible management software.
about.heroTitle: Building the Future of Auto Service
about.heroSubtitle: We believe every garage — from a family shop to a multi-branch service center — deserves modern tools to run their business.
about.storyDesc: TOLOM was born in Mongolia, where auto service businesses were still running on paper — handwritten work orders, notebooks for customer records, and sticky notes for inventory. We built TOLOM to change that: a platform designed from the ground up for the way Mongolian garages actually work. Today, hundreds of shops across the country trust TOLOM to manage their daily operations.
about.missionText: To empower every auto service business with modern, accessible, and affordable management software. We're building the operating system that auto shops deserve — one that makes their work easier, their customers happier, and their businesses more profitable.
about.value1Desc: We believe software should make your job easier, not harder. Every feature we build is designed with one question: does this save our users time?
about.value2Desc: Your business data is too important to risk. We build on enterprise-grade infrastructure with bank-level encryption and automatic backups.
about.value3Desc: We understand the unique needs of Mongolian auto service businesses and the specific vehicle models common on Mongolian roads.
about.value4Desc: We ship updates every week based on real feedback from our users. TOLOM today is already better than it was last month, and next month it will be better still.
about.teamDesc: We're a small, passionate team building the future of auto service management. We work closely with our users to make sure every feature solves a real problem.
about.ctaTitle: Join hundreds of auto shops on TOLOM
